name: FEG
rootCause: The FEG project suffered an attack resulting in a loss of approximately $1 million. Analysis suggests that the root cause of the incident appears to be a composability issue arising from the integration with the underlying Wormhole cross-chain bridge, which facilitates cross-chain message and token transfers.
